changes: No changes to content. I checked the date: NS 1063 Pauṣa śukla 1 falls on Thursday 7 January 1943, which matches 'roja 5'. A short note on this was added.

date.as_written: saṃmvata 1063 varṣya paukhamāse suklapakṣe pratipadāyān tithau 1 roja 5

notes: The colophon names no people. It ends with the date the copying was finished ('coya sidhayakā jula'), followed by a devotional exhortation in Newari about taking refuge in Śrī Karuṇāmaya. The colophon only says 'saṃvat'. Reading it as Nepāla Saṃvat fits the Devanagari script, the Newari text and the loanword 'roja'. NS 1063 Pauṣa śukla pratipadā works out to Thursday 7 January 1943, which agrees with 'roja 5'.
